question: Which of the following types of chisels is used for separating metals after chain drilling?
solution:
The correct answer is __Web chisel**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Web chisel__ is a specialized type of chisel used in metalworking.
 
• It is specifically designed for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
• The process of chain drilling involves drilling a series of holes close to one another to create a weakened area in the metal. 
 
• A web chisel is then used to cut and separate the material along the weakened line.
 
• This tool is essential for precision work in metal fabrication and repair jobs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Flat Chisel:**

 
 
• Flat chisels are commonly used for shaping and cutting metals.
 
• They are not ideal for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
 
 
• **Cross-cut Chisel: **
 
 
• Cross-cut chisels are used for cutting grooves and slots in metal surfaces.
 
• They are not typically used for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
 
 
• **Diamond Point Chisel:**
 
 
• Diamond point chisels are used for creating precise indentations or marks.
 
• They are not suitable for cutting or separating metals after chain drilling.
